rules: Each generation n+1 binds its parent generation hash
All previous generation objects and nested contact arrays are immutable
A held decision is appended as a record and never erased
Only a completed verification can advance measured phase progress
Phase II frozen source identities may never be retroactively changed by Phase III
notes: LocalStorage journal uses write-once per-generation receipts and writes head last; browser-origin storage is not tamper-proof against a malicious same-origin actor.
Malformed or interrupted persisted history locks appends rather than silently clearing its ancestry.
Every generational provenance trace descends from exactly one frozen Phase II source root; repeated descendants cannot be counted as independent witnesses.
The per-generation fingerprint is a deterministic FNV64 consistency check, not a cryptographic proof against an adversary controlling the same origin.
ADA-204N adds a separately derived immutable three-contact ledger; it does not change pinned generations or write-once ADA-202N journal entries.
Jane observes, Toph gates stability and energy, ADA deterministically APPENDs or HOLDs; HOLD remains a recorded generation event.
ADA-205N growth is dimensionless ×1.025 (a 2.5% increase) for each eligible APPEND; HOLD retains the previous size while preserving the generation event.
Growth is a separate deterministic derived ledger; existing pinned source, journal and contact records remain unchanged.
ADA-206N adaptive proposals derive from observed Jane/Toph deltas; per eligible step ±0.025 and total ±0.25, with zero mutation on HOLD.
The adaptive policy ledger is separately derived and immutable; Phase II, generation journals, inherited contacts and 1.025 growth remain unchanged.
ADA-207N uses a bounded 24-entry active memory view with capacity 1–256, retaining every generation in the existing write-once journal.
The first active record preserves its parent hash pointing into archived history; any source mutation invalidates the entire derived memory proof.
